3213.sector_method: Rugged/commercial/repair segment revenue, H2 margin and inventory conversion
3213.normalization: Remove H1 FVTPL 2.962 and FX 3.275 at estimated 25% marginal tax; unchanged NCI. FVOCI equity disposal gains are already outside EPS. Retain ordinary interest and associate profit; do not remove inventory and scrap costs.

6005.sector_method: Brokerage activity, financing spreads, net trading, associate earnings; capital/liquidity rather than FCF
6005.normalization: Remove selected H1 investment disposal 1178.667 and liability release 43.295 at estimated 20% marginal tax, NCI unchanged. Retain net ordinary trading and paired hedge P&L. This is a selected-gain sensitivity, not through-cycle EPS. Nine-month profit inferred from rounded EPS has +/-12.276485 million uncertainty.

6165.sector_method: Live-device/other revenue, gross margin, subsidiary remittances and debt redemption
6165.normalization: Neutralize H1 discrete bond-redemption loss 18.032, disposal gain 7.997, FVTPL loss 11.069 and FX gain 5.582; tax sensitivity 22%-25%, point 23.5%, NCI 1.390 unchanged. Forecast shares 75.7/77.9 are inherited proxies and not a completed dilution reconciliation.

5515.sector_method: Executable construction backlog, project progress and gross margin; customer advances and commitments
5515.normalization: Core H1 proxy removes FVTPL 724.148, disposal 111.000 and compensation reversal 16.600 from group pretax 1407.063, then applies estimated 20% tax and zero NCI. Reported-style FY2026 retains actual H1 parent profit plus H2 core, with no forecast additional portfolio gain. Actual portfolio and NCI attribution remains unverified.

2348.sector_method: Agency versus development recognition, segment margins, funding and guarantees
2348.normalization: Remove net H1 FVTPL gain 23.980 at estimated 20% tax; retain small FX 0.111. Do not mistake Q2 gain 112.849 for H1 net gain. Deduct annual preferred dividend 48 once. Common shares reflect 0.5 stock dividend; diluted 159.7 is an explicit employee-share proxy.

2382.sector_method: AI/server deployment proxy, pass-through mix and operating margin; working capital, GDR earmarks and dilution
2382.normalization: H1 diluted numerator 49950.168 already reverses issuer embedded-derivative gain 408.202: remove FX 6521.848 + remaining FVTPL 411.934 + disposal 178.561 at estimated 20% tax, not all FVTPL a second time. Basic profit removes full FVTPL 820.136. GDR adds 245 million shares on Aug 3; weighted issuance and convertible/employee dilution modeled explicitly. Future if-converted addbacks are estimates.

2603.sector_method: Liftings/rates/route mix via quarterly revenue proxy and operating margin; subsidiary remittances and vessel funding
2603.normalization: Remove H1 FX 336.733 and FVTPL 0.931 at estimated 20% tax, NCI unchanged. Freight-rate cyclicality remains ordinary earnings, not a one-off to delete. Use a separate TWD 22-28 mid-cycle valuation sensitivity; FY2026 is a peak-cycle forecast.

2727.sector_method: Store/cohort and same-store sales proxy, food/labor/occupancy operating margin; lease-adjusted parent cash
2727.normalization: Basic/common profit removes H1 FX 8.780, issuer FVTPL gain 0.350 and lease-modification gain 4.646 at estimated 20% tax. Diluted numerator starts from actual 821.952, which already reverses issuer gain 0.350; remove only FX and lease gain, retaining known H1 if-converted interest and estimated H2 addback 5. Retain disposal loss 6.851 and impairment 8.552 as ordinary closure/expansion costs. Annual dilution proxy uses H1 85.865 million, dividend-participating shares 82.8591 million; future conversion can raise the cash denominator.
